value.createAccount: Create an account to back up and sign in anywhere
value.signInAgain: Sign in again to change this

hint.name: Changes the name shown in the app

gate.local: This is a local profile on this phone, so there’s no account email or password to change.
gate.noPassword: There’s no account password to remove. You sign in with an email code.

name.label: Your name
name.local: Optional. Kept on this phone only.
name.account: Optional. Saved to your CityTurfer account.

email.intro: To keep your account safe, we’ll first email a code to your current address, {current}.
email.currentSent: We emailed a 6-digit code to {current}. It works for 10 minutes.
email.newHint: We’ll email a code there to check it’s yours.
email.newSent: We emailed a 6-digit code to {next}. Enter it to finish.
email.done: Your email is now {next}. Use it to sign in. Other phones and browsers were signed out; we sent a note to your old address.

password.stepUp: First we’ll email a code to {email}, to check it’s you.
password.sent: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. A few words you’ll remember work well.
password.actionText: Change it, or remove it and sign in with email codes only.

passwordIntro.set: An account password is optional: you can always sign in with an email code instead.
passwordIntro.change: Choose a new account password. Email codes keep working too.
passwordIntro.remove: Without an account password, you sign in with an email code.

passwordDone.set: Your account password is set. Other phones and browsers were signed out.
passwordDone.change: Your account password has been changed. Other phones and browsers were signed out.
passwordDone.remove: Your account password has been removed. Sign in with an email code from now on.

screen.dataBackedUp: On this phone, backed up ({backedUp} of {total})
screen.recordingText: Finish or discard your recording first.
screen.unsyncedText: {count, plural, one {# activity has changes that aren't on the server yet. They stay on this phone either way.} other {# activities have changes that aren't on the server yet. They stay on this phone either way.}}

export.requestedText: We'll email a download link to {email}. It works once, for 24 hours.
export.rateLimitedText: You can ask for one export a day. Check your email for the last link.
export.noEmailText: This account has no email to send the link to. Sign in with your email first.
export.authText: Sign in again, then ask for your export.
export.notSignedInText: This phone isn’t signed in to your account any more. Sign out, sign in with your email, then ask for your export.

delete.confirmText: Your account and everything on our server (backup, consents, exports) is deleted for good. This can’t be undone.
delete.localText: Keep your activities and turf here, or delete them too?
delete.localTextAdmin: Keep your activities and turf here, or delete them too? Deleting also removes this phone’s history from before the account (the local admin profile uses the same data).
delete.authText: Your sign-in has expired. Nothing was deleted. Sign out, sign in with your email, then delete your account.
delete.notSignedInText: This phone isn’t signed in to your account any more. Nothing was deleted. Sign out, sign in with your email, then delete your account.
delete.localPendingText: Your account is deleted. This phone’s copy of your activities couldn’t be deleted just now; CityTurfer deletes it the next time it opens.
delete.offlineText: Nothing was deleted. Try again when you’re online.
delete.failedText: Nothing was deleted. Try again in a moment.
